# nemau network

Networks, subnets, floating IPs, security groups.

## Usage

```
nemau network [command]
```

Alias: `net`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [capabilities](nemau_network_capabilities.md) | Show which optional network features the region offers |
| [floating-ip](nemau_network_floating-ip.md) | Manage floating IPs |
| [interface](nemau_network_interface.md) | List the instances' network interfaces |
| [security-group](nemau_network_security-group.md) | Manage security groups |
| [subnet](nemau_network_subnet.md) | Manage subnets |
| [vpc](nemau_network_vpc.md) | Manage virtual networks |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
